lines: From the same position, fitting more scenery on the same screen lets us see more of our surroundings.
But with a perspective camera, the same object in the center appears smaller.
Narrowing the view makes the object ahead larger, but it is easier to miss something approaching from the side.
Seeing the sides clearly is little help if the car ahead becomes a speck. Staring at that car and missing the one beside us is not ideal either.
Reading the surroundings and distinguishing small objects: the right balance depends on the game.
